programs.name: suflip
programs.purpose: Rotate, transpose, or reverse a seismic data panel.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUFLIP - flip a data set in various ways

params.name: flip
params.description: Direction: -1 or 1 rotates, 0 transposes, 2 reverses traces, and 3 reverses samples.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable if set, otherwise empty
params.description: Directory for temporary trace and header files; an empty value uses tmpfile.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print temporary-file and dimension information.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Samples are copied without arithmetic. For transposed output, the code reads one stored header per output trace even when there are more output traces than input headers; the checked read can fail.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers the entire panel and rearranges samples and headers using temporary files.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=16 ntr=8 | suflip flip=0
suplane nt=16 ntr=8 | suflip flip=2
suplane nt=16 ntr=8 | suflip flip=3

programs.name: sufwmix
programs.purpose: Mix traces within gathers in the frequency domain using header-based distances.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUFWMIX -  FX domain multidimensional Weighted Mix

params.name: key
params.description: Header keys defining distance dimensions; selfdoc calls this required, but the code does not enforce it.

params.name: dx
params.description: Distance unit for each key.

params.name: keyg
params.description: Header key defining gathers.

params.name: vf
params.description: Enable frequency-dependent distance limit; selfdoc incorrectly says default 0.

params.name: vmin
params.description: Velocity used for the frequency-dependent limit.

params.name: padd
params.description: FFT padding percentage.

params.name: fac
params.description: Distance scaling factor, clamped to at least 1.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT results, float accumulation order, and double sqrt affect reproducibility. weightsum=+weight overwrites rather than accumulates; crmul's return value is discarded, so normalization has no effect. The frequency limit divides by zero at DC. The first trace is selected if no trace is marked.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers gathers and performs multidimensional weighted mixing with forward and inverse FFTs.

test_cases.description: Mix one gather without frequency limiting.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=8 | sushw key=ep a=1 | sufwmiX key=tracl dx=1 vf=0

programs.license_note: Credits Potash Corporation, Balazs Nemeth, for code given to CWP in 2008.

programs.name: sumath
programs.purpose: Apply a scalar arithmetic operation to every sample and optionally duplicate traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUMATH - do math operation on su data

params.name: op
params.description: Operation: add, sub, mult, div, pow, or spow.

params.name: a
params.description: Scalar operand.

params.name: copy
params.description: Number of copies of each output trace.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: pow uses the platform math library and converts its double result to float; division by zero and invalid powers follow platform floating-point behavior.
programs.difficulty_reason: It applies independent sample operations and copies traces.

test_cases.description: Add a constant and duplicate traces.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sumath op=add a=2.5 copy=2
suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | sumath op=spow a=1.5

programs.name: sumix
programs.purpose: Apply a weighted moving mix across successive traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUMIX - compute weighted moving average (trace MIX) on a panel

params.name: mix
params.description: Weights, ordered from current trace to older traces; each is divided by the number of weights.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Weights are divided by the number of traces, not their sum; products accumulate in float in weight order. The first nmix-1 traces pass unchanged.
programs.difficulty_reason: It maintains a rolling buffer of multiple traces.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=8 | sumix mix=1,2,1
suplane nt=32 ntr=8 | sumix

programs.name: suop
programs.purpose: Apply a selected unary arithmetic, derivative, or window operation to each trace.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUOP - do unary arithmetic operation on segys

params.name: op
params.description: Unary operation; choices include arithmetic and transcendental functions, derivatives, integration, extrema, and window statistics.

params.name: nw
params.description: Window length for mean, std, var, and despike; even values are incremented.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Many operations use platform transcendental functions, float accumulations, and data-dependent divisions. slog2 falls through to slog10. Several extrema and derivative branches write tmp[nt] out of bounds; freq dereferences unallocated tmp1. Some branches use uninitialized edge values, and std/var retain the sum when accumulating squared deviations.
programs.difficulty_reason: The many operation branches include windowed statistics, sorting, stateful integration, and irregular edge handling.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | suop op=slog10
suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | suop op=mean nw=5
suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | suop op=despike nw=5
suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | suop op=diff

programs.name: suop2
programs.purpose: Combine two SU files with a binary sample operation or interleave their samples.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUOP2 - do a binary operation on two data sets

params.name: op
params.description: Panel or panel-trace operation, zipper, or zippol.

params.name: w1
params.description: First-file weight; panel scaling occurs only when both weights are nonzero.

params.name: w2
params.description: Second-file weight; selfdoc says 1.0, but code initializes it to zero.

params.name: trid
params.description: Output trace identification for zipper and zippol; FUNPACKNYQ is 111.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: zippol uses platform sin and cos. Complex arithmetic has special and incomplete division branches. Panel-trace scaling uses nt before it is initialized from the first panel trace, so the first scaling loops do nothing.
programs.difficulty_reason: It reads two files and applies sample-wise binary operations.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 > in1.su && suplane nt=32 ntr=4 > in2.su && suop2 in1.su in2.su op=sum w1=0.5 w2=2
suplane nt=32 ntr=4 > in1.su && suplane nt=32 ntr=1 > in2.su && suop2 in1.su in2.su op=ptquo
suplane nt=32 ntr=4 > in1.su && suplane nt=32 ntr=4 > in2.su && suop2 in1.su in2.su op=zippol trid=111

programs.name: supermute
programs.purpose: Permute, reverse, and subsample the axes of a three-dimensional data cube.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPERMUTE - permute or transpose a 3d datacube

params.name: n1
params.description: Input fast-axis size.

params.name: n2
params.description: Input middle-axis size.

params.name: n3
params.description: Input slow-axis size.

params.name: o1
params.description: Input axis used as output fast axis.

params.name: o2
params.description: Input axis used as output middle axis.

params.name: o3
params.description: Input axis used as output slow axis.

params.name: d1
params.description: Output fast-axis stride; negative reverses the axis.

params.name: d2
params.description: Output middle-axis stride; negative reverses the axis.

params.name: d3
params.description: Output slow-axis stride; negative reverses the axis.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print dimensions and optionally individual mappings or output values.

params.name: check
params.description: Enable mapping bounds checks and trace progress messages.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Samples are copied without arithmetic. Duplicate output axes are not rejected, which can leave cube elements uninitialized; the ntr header calculation has unusual integer precedence.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers and remaps a complete three-dimensional cube.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=16 ntr=8 | supermute n1=16 n2=8 n3=1 o1=2 o2=1 o3=3
suplane nt=16 ntr=8 | supermute n1=16 n2=4 n3=2 o1=1 o2=3 o3=2 d1=-2 d2=1 d3=1 check=1

programs.name: surecmo
programs.purpose: Mix each trace with preceding traces to compensate for a moving marine streamer.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SURECMO - compensate for the continuously moving streamer in marine

params.name: dt
params.description: Sample interval in microseconds.

params.name: vb
params.description: Boat speed in meters per second.

params.name: dx
params.description: Channel spacing in meters.

params.name: fill
params.description: Listed in selfdoc but never read or applied; padding is zero.

params.name: tmax
params.description: Listed in the usage line but never read or applied.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Weights and sample products accumulate in float, with double constants in the weight expression. Default dx=0 causes division by zero or NaN; initial preceding traces are zero-filled.
programs.difficulty_reason: It maintains a three-trace rolling buffer with time-varying weights.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | surecmo vb=2.5 dx=25 dt=4000

test_cases.description: Exercise weights beyond the first channel interval.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | surecmo vb=10 dx=1 dt=4000

programs.name: susimmat
programs.purpose: Compute a time-by-time similarity matrix between input traces and a trace from a file.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSIMAT - Correlation similarity matrix for two traces.

params.name: sufile
params.description: SU file supplying the comparison trace.

params.name: panel
params.description: Listed in selfdoc, but never read; code always uses the first file trace.

params.name: mt
params.description: Correlation window length; values other than 1 and 21 are rounded up to odd.

params.name: eps
params.description: Stabilizer for normalized measures.

params.name: taper
params.description: Set to 1 for exponential window taper.

params.name: method
params.description: Similarity method: correlation, normalized angle, regression, or vector angle.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print method and adjusted window information.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Window products accumulate in float; exp, sqrt, acos, and regression affect reproducibility. Method 2 overwrites normalized correlation with an angle. Taper alpha uses integer division. High-edge window handling can index beyond the valid trace samples.
programs.difficulty_reason: It builds a full similarity matrix with sliding correlation windows and optional regression.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=16 ntr=1 > ref.su && suplane nt=16 ntr=1 | susimmat sufile=ref.su mt=5 method=1
suplane nt=16 ntr=1 > ref.su && suplane nt=16 ntr=1 | susimmat sufile=ref.su mt=5 method=4 taper=1 eps=0.01

programs.license_note: The header cites papers in The Leading Edge and GEOPHYSICS as references.

programs.name: suvcat
programs.purpose: Append corresponding traces from two files with an optional overlap.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUVCAT -  append one data set to another, with or without an

params.name: taplen
params.description: Number of overlapping samples.

params.name: taptype
params.description: Overlap combination: average, maximum magnitude, cosine, or sum.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Overlap arithmetic uses float and cosine uses platform libm. The cosine taper computes i/(taplen-1) using integer division; taplen=1 causes integer division by zero. Invalid overlap lengths can cause out-of-bounds access.
programs.difficulty_reason: It combines corresponding traces with a small selection of overlap formulas.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 > in1.su && suplane nt=32 ntr=4 > in2.su && suvcat in1.su in2.su taplen=4 taptype=0
suplane nt=32 ntr=4 > in1.su && suplane nt=32 ntr=4 > in2.su && suvcat in1.su in2.su taplen=4 taptype=2
suplane nt=32 ntr=4 > in1.su && suplane nt=32 ntr=4 > in2.su && suvcat in1.su in2.su taplen=4 taptype=3

programs.name: suvlength
programs.purpose: Pad or truncate variable-length input traces to a common sample count.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUVLENGTH - Adjust variable length traces to common length

params.name: ns
params.description: Number of samples in every output trace.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Existing samples are copied unchanged and padding is zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: It reads variable-length traces and pads or truncates their samples.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | suvlength ns=48
suplane nt=32 ntr=4 | suvlength ns=16
